defects.claim: `orgName`, `lastShippedAt` and `poolPercentUsed` are read from `GET /api/v1/dashboard` but nothing in the checkout sends them. The mock's `getDashboard` at src/lib/api/mockAdapter.ts:2083 is just `return buildDashboard(windowDays)`, and grepping `src/` for these names finds them only in httpAdapter.ts, types.ts, DashboardView.vue and the view spec. The fixture src/lib/api/__tests__/fixtures/dashboard.json:3 has only `"stats": { "shipped": 8, "needsYou": 2 }`. So the header shows "—" and never shows "Pool" in every real or mock run.
`timeToPrMinutes` has no producer either. The fixture stats at dashboard.json:3 do not include it and the mock does not emit it, so Time to PR always renders "—".

The issue asks for Pool `<percent_used>%`. That field already exists in the billing allowance contract (src/lib/api/httpAdapter.ts:342 `percent_used?: number`, mapped at httpAdapter.ts:422 `percentUsed:`), but the PR invents a new dashboard field `poolPercentUsed` that no producer sends. The view never calls `getAllowance`.

The org name comes from the dashboard payload, which has no producer for it. The app's real org source is `auth.org?.name`, as used at src/design-system/components/AppHeader.vue:151 `const orgName = computed(() => auth.org?.name ?? '')`. So the header's left side is always "—".

The new GH-249 tests stub `mockAdapter.getDashboard` with `makeDashboard({ orgName: 'Acme', … poolPercentUsed: 42 })`. httpAdapter.spec.ts has no test for the new wire keys (the grep finds none), so nothing checks that `toDashboard` maps a real payload.

The "no $ or tokens on a platform-key tenant" test never sets up a platform-key tenant. No session/platformKey state is seeded, and the header markup at DashboardView.vue:297-301 does not branch on tenant type, so the assertion passes trivially.
This breaks the CLAUDE.md rule "Adapter/mock/fixtures move in lockstep". The Wire types and mapping changed, but `buildDashboard` and dashboard.json did not.

The Delivered numerator goes through the default slot, so it misses the green `text-ds-green` numerator style that StatCard's `numerator`/`denominator` variant gives (src/design-system/components/StatCard.vue:63). The "/100" denominator is also a hardcoded literal, not a value from the payload.
Raw `Math.round(poolPercent)` and `~${Math.round(m)}` formatting is done inline in the template and computed, instead of using a shared formatter. This is a style point only.
